what: An object literal declares the same key more than once. The last value wins.

street.headline: You put `{1}` two times inside one object
street.happen: The object get `{1}` two times. JavaScript go keep the last one, so the first value disappear quietly.
street.todo: Remove one of them, or rename the second key.
street.learn: "duplicate key" mean say the same key show more than once.
